// diagnostic

L0107

Case `{type_name}.{name}` is never built.

What

Case `{type_name}.{name}` is never built.

Why

Code may match this case, but nothing creates it, so the arms that handle it never run. Decoding and foreign code count as building it; matching does not.

Fix

Remove the case, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when it is intentional.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0107: Tests/UI/member_liveness_case_built_match_only.stderr.

Error [jet.UnbuiltCase]: Case `Light.Off` is never built.
